purpose: Prove that Prometeo is actually using its intended mechanisms and detect shallow execution before promotion.
claim_protocol: Use exclusive create-if-absent claims under coordination/opportunities/claims/<opportunity_id>.json. Never overwrite another claim. Losing a race means reload all active queues and choose another compatible READY opportunity.
run_protocol: Persist claim -> STARTED -> context receipt/checkpoints -> RETURN -> DONE. Shared authority heads are off-limits.

opportunities.mission: Audit the first identical-worker canary wave from durable evidence only. Reconstruct claims, STARTED runs, returns, DONE/boundary states, collision behavior, duplicate-work risk, missing lineage, post-return continuation and actual useful outputs. Compare against VERIFICATION_AND_CRITIC_CONTROL_V1 and the canary success criteria. Produce PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL per mechanism with exact evidence refs and concrete fixes. Do not infer success from prose or file existence.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Evidence matrix for claim uniqueness, STARTED-before-work, return completeness, post-return continuation, worker depth, failure modes and exact remediation opportunities.

opportunities.mission: Design the smallest deterministic progress/throughput compiler from claims/runs/returns/integration/generation evidence. It must calculate real metrics from VERIFICATION_AND_CRITIC_CONTROL_V1 without inventing percentages, support time buckets and generations, and expose critic-trigger conditions. Produce exact schema, inputs, algorithm, output artifact and implementation canary.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Executable compiler blueprint + metric schema + falsification cases.

opportunities.mission: Design a canary that proves Context Fabric is actually used rather than merely documented. Given a planner/worker mission, require an L0/L1/L2 context receipt, compare selected sources against a gold/reference set, test stale/authority/contradiction omission, and measure files/tokens opened versus repository scan. Define PASS/FAIL and exact durable evidence.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Context-use canary with gold set, receipts, omission tests, efficiency metrics and promotion gate.

opportunities.mission: Turn the critic-trigger policy into an operational scheduling contract. Use event-based triggers plus the 10-return backstop, define critic independence requirements, evidence inputs, anti-recursion limits, how findings become Planner inputs, and how to detect that critics are producing ritual summaries rather than route-changing value.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Operational critic scheduler contract + quality/falsification criteria + Planner handoff.

opportunities.mission: Define when one worker should continue through multiple sequential checkpoints versus split into parallel workers. Build an acceptance-criteria/checkpoint protocol that prevents shallow early stopping but avoids unsafe mega-workers. Include max chain rules, fresh-critic boundaries, context reuse, failure isolation and durable checkpoint receipts.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Worker depth/checkpoint contract with decision matrix and canary tests.
